items.title: Garmin Patents Non-Invasive HbA1c Tracking via Wrist Sensors
items.summary: Garmin filed a patent (US 20260033750) for estimating glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) using optical PPG sensors already in its watches. Uses pulse spectroscopy AC/DC ratios across wavelengths — no needles. Could ship in Fenix 9 or Venu 5 with Elevate 6 sensor, pending FDA clearance.
items.relevance: Non-invasive HbA1c from a wristwatch would be huge for T1D families. Not real-time glucose, but long-term trend tracking without blood draws — directly relevant to AVA's mission of making diabetes management less burdensome

items.title: FDA Expands MiniMed 780G Label — Now Works with Ultra-Rapid Insulins Fiasp & Lyumjev
items.summary: Medtronic receives 510(k) clearance for MiniMed 780G with Novo Nordisk's Fiasp and Eli Lilly's Lyumjev. Also cleared for Abbott's Instinct CGM with Type 2 diabetes. Medicare beneficiaries can now access the full system.
items.relevance: Ultra-rapid insulins with auto-delivery = faster correction, fewer missed-meal penalties. AVA's insulin action curves could model Fiasp/Lyumjev profiles to teach kids how different insulins behave

items.title: Abbott Hit with FDA Warning Letter Over Libre CGM Accuracy — Sensors Recalled
items.summary: FDA issued a warning letter to Abbott over accuracy problems with FreeStyle Libre CGMs. Certain Libre 3 and Libre 3 Plus sensors recalled due to incorrect glucose readings. Abbott must address manufacturing quality issues.
items.relevance: Major CGM reliability issue — Libre is one of the most popular CGMs for kids. Reinforces why AVA's education on recognizing symptoms (not just trusting devices) matters. Kaislyn's family should check sensor lot numbers

items.title: Claude Opus 4.6 Launches — Agent Teams, 1M Context, Financial Analysis
items.summary: Anthropic's Opus 4.6 introduces 'agent teams' for parallel multi-agent coding, 1M token context, and deep financial analysis capabilities. Triggered second wave of the 'SaaSpocalypse' stock selloff as Wall Street fears AI replacing entire software categories.
items.relevance: You're running on this model right now. Agent teams could parallelize AVA development — one agent on SwiftUI, another on ESP32 firmware, another on test cases, all coordinated

items.title: OpenAI Drops GPT-5.3-Codex Minutes After Opus 4.6 — AI Coding Arms Race
items.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5.3-Codex within minutes of Anthropic's Opus 4.6, claiming it can 'build complex games and apps from scratch over days.' First model that helped debug and deploy itself. Built to supercharge Codex agentic coding.
items.relevance: The AI coding race is white-hot — both major labs dropped models within 15 minutes. Competition means better tools for building AVA faster. Worth evaluating Codex for specific tasks

items.title: Anthropic's Cowork Causes $285B Stock Rout — 'SaaSpocalypse' Arrives
items.summary: Claude Cowork's 11 industry plugins (legal, finance, HR, productivity) triggered a $285 billion selloff across SaaS, financial services, and asset management stocks. Goldman Sachs now deploying Claude agents for trade accounting and compliance.
items.relevance: AI is now reshaping trillion-dollar industries in real-time. The same platform you build on daily just shook Wall Street — speaks to the leverage you get from building on Claude

items.title: WIRED: CGMs Can Actually Help You Lose Weight — New Evidence
items.summary: New research featured in WIRED shows continuous glucose monitors help with weight management even for non-diabetics. CGM data drives better food choices by providing immediate feedback on glucose responses to meals.
items.relevance: CGMs going mainstream beyond diabetes — expanding the total addressable market for glucose education tools like AVA. Understanding glucose responses is becoming a general wellness topic

items.title: GitHub Now Offers Claude & Codex as Coding Agents in Public Preview
items.summary: Claude by Anthropic and OpenAI Codex available as coding agents for Copilot Pro+ and Enterprise. Assign autonomous tasks directly from GitHub issues and PRs — agents write code, create PRs, and iterate on feedback.
items.relevance: Direct integration with your repos — assign Claude to AVA app features or ESP32 firmware autonomously from GitHub issues. Streamlines the development workflow significantly
